jobs.title: Lead Technical Product Manager, ITC
jobs.description:
WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

As a Lead Product Manager in Nike’s India Technology Center (ITC), you will play a key role in the Consumer Product & Innovation (CP&I) team—the technology engine behind Nike’s product creation, merchandising, design, and innovation. You will work closely with global Product, Engineering, Architecture, Experience, Data & Analytics, Program Management, and Business partners across Nike’s matrixed ecosystem. Your work will accelerate Nike’s digital product creation capabilities and help deliver scalable, enterprise-grade solutions used across Footwear, Apparel, and Accessories. You will report to a Director/Senior Director of Product Management and collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to align vision, define priorities, and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking a strategic yet hands-on Lead Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of product vision, technical depth, and stakeholder alignment. You bring a data-driven mindset, strong product execution skills, and the ability to simplify complex problems into clear product decisions. You excel at balancing long-term strategic vision with day-to-day execution, synthesizing insights, leading cross-functional teams, and communicating clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.
Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent. MBA preferred.
- 5+ years of product management experience (web/mobile/enterprise platforms preferred)
- Strong analytical and critical thinking capabilities
- Experience in Agile delivery models and iterative development
- Strong understanding of technology architectures, APIs, and platforms
- Excellent communication and stakeholder alignment skills
- Team-first mindset with willingness to roll up sleeves
Preferred:
- Experience in consumer, retail, footwear, apparel, or digital product creation ecosystems
- Background in platform product management
- Experience managing executive communications or business presentations

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

As a Lead PM in CP&I, you will own the roadmap and lifecycle of key platform or product capabilities that power Nike’s global product creation ecosystem. Core responsibilities include:
- Defining product vision, strategy, and roadmap
- Driving discovery, prioritization, development, rollout, and adoption
- Translating user needs into technical requirements with Engineering
- Collaborating with business stakeholders to define priorities and success metrics
- Optimizing user journeys and platform health across CP&I tools and services
- Making evidence-based trade-offs between user needs, complexity, and business value
- Investigating issues, performing root-cause analysis, closing systemic gaps
- Driving consistency in product quality, documentation, KPIs, and roadmap communication
- Establishing and communicating performance metrics across the organization

jobs.title: Lead Technical Product Manager Finance, ITC
jobs.description:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

The candidate will join a collaborative team of finance transformation specialists, solution architects, and analysts who focus on building scalable financial models within the Anaplan SaaS solution The group combines technical expertise with financial domain knowledge to deliver enterprise-grade finance planning solutions.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to shape and drive the product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for Nike's Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) capabilities at the intersection of Anaplan and our integrated data landscape. This individual will serve as the primary product manager for financial planning and performance management and associated data solutions, partnering closely with Finance, FP&A, Engineering, Architecture, and business leaders to deliver modern planning capabilities that enable better decision-making across the enterprise.

The ideal candidate combines deep product management expertise with a strong understanding of financial planning processes, enterprise software platforms and data solutions, and business transformation. You are comfortable operating across strategy and execution, translating complex business challenges into scalable product solutions while influencing senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

You have a passion for building products that drive measurable business value, improve planning effectiveness, and simplify complex planning processes through technology, data, and automation.
The successful candidate will possess the following skills and experiences:
- 8+ years of experience in Technical Product Management with responsibility for leading high-complexity products in a cross-functional environment

- Proven ability to define and execute product strategies in support of scaled investments involving Finance, Supply Chain, Treasury, and Enterprise Planning functions.

- Experience leading cross-functional squads through full product lifecycle from discovery to delivery

- Strong FP&A experience within integrated EPM platforms, especially Anaplan

- Deep understanding of data ecosystems, data governance, data warehousing, and enterprise reporting platforms including Databricks.

- Experience working with Agile delivery teams and managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.

- Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior business and technology leaders.

- Solid understanding of FP&A and the Income Statement. Integrations with AWS, Azure, Databricks, and maintaining strong data hygiene.

- Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving capabilities.

- Experience with cloud technologies, APIs, ETL/ELT platforms, and enterprise integration patterns is preferred.

- Anaplan Solution Architect, Model Builder, or related certifications are a plus.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead end-to-end product strategy at the intersection of enterprise data solutions and the Anaplan SaaS platform

- Partner with Finance, Supply Chain, Treasury, and business teams to translate planning and analytics needs into scalable solutions.

- Monitor product performance, define metrics, adoption tracking, and drive continuous improvement fuelled by data

- Drive planning, prioritisation, risk management, and stakeholder alignment across multiple workstreams.

- Oversee Anaplan platform enhancements, integrations, and model lifecycle management.

- Collaborate with engineering and data teams to enable reliable, high-quality data products and insights.

- Establish delivery governance, operational metrics, and continuous improvement practices.

- Champion innovation through automation, AI-driven planning, and modern data capabilities.

jobs.title: Lead Technical Product Manager, ITC
jobs.description:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
As a Lead Product Manager, you will own product strategy and roadmaps for Cloud Integration team within Finance, Procurement & Technology. This role is driven by executing strategic priorities and ensuring a product vision is carried out through actions and measurable product discipline.
As a Lead Product Manager, you will focus on driving excellence in product and platform strategy and execution. You will work in close collaboration with various teams within Global Technology (e.g., Architecture, Engineering, Product Management, Program Management) and key Functional Teams across the business (e.g., Finance, Tax, Procurement, Order To Cash, Treasury, Royalties, General Accounting etc). The role will require experience designing creative, quality technical products and enabling business capabilities and objectives through technology.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We are looking for a Lead Product Manager who is a strategic thinker, execution-driven leader, and passionate advocate for building enterprise-grade platforms that scale. You are equally comfortable defining long-term product vision as you are rolling up your sleeves to unblock a squad on delivery. You thrive at the intersection of business, technology, and user needs — and you know how to translate ambiguity into clear, actionable roadmaps.

Skillset Required
We're looking for someone with at least 6+ years of experience in product management and clearly demonstrated these skills:
- Bachelor's Degree or a combination of relevant education, experience, and training.
- Experience of working on technology solutions supporting procurement processes (Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, Invoice receipts, Three-way Match, Payments, and Remittance).
- Nice to have experience of working on one or more solutions such as SAP Finance and Procurement solutions, Procurement Solutions (COUPA, Fieldglass), and Integration Technologies (AWS Microservices, FUSION, NiFi).
- Strong product management expertise.
- Lead the execution of an end-to-end product/platform vision and multi-year roadmap in partnership with Engineering teams and the Finance business.
- Partner with all stakeholders to understand Business needs, outcomes and value and ensure roadmaps are aligned to those needs.
- Ensure roadmaps account for and integrate dependencies across functional areas within Domains along with technical enablement work as part of platform strategy.
- Collaborating with other Product managers and leaders to address dependencies across teams
- Experience of working in Agile Team following Scrum and experience of working on JIRA and managing day to day product manager activities (Daily Scrum, Backlog Refinement, Planning, and Review), communications and contributing to senior management reports and business presentations.
- Experience working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment for global and country-specific solutions.
- Strong Analytical, problem solving, and Data Visualization Skills.
- Preferred to have Finance business function knowledge
- Excellent communication skills.
- Validated ability to adapt to new technologies and tools, changing needs, processes, and ambiguity.
- Preferred to have AI/ML experience

What YOU’LL WORK ON
- Define and own the multi-year product vision and roadmap for cloud-based integration capabilities supporting Finance domain
- Drive the end-to-end product lifecycle — from discovery and requirements definition, through design, delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement — in close partnership with Architecture, Engineering, and Program Management
- Shape the integration platform strategy leveraging technologies such as AWS microservices, and Apache NiFi, ensuring the platform is scalable, resilient, observable, and cost-efficient
- Partner with business stakeholders across Finance, Tax, Procurement, Order-to-Cash, Treasury, Royalties, and General Accounting to understand pain points, capture business capabilities, and translate them into prioritized product outcomes.
- Manage the product backlog and delivery cadence in an Agile/Scrum environment — leading Daily Scrums, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Planning, Reviews, and Retrospectives — using JIRA to drive transparency and velocity.
- Orchestrate cross-domain dependencies by collaborating with other Product Managers and Domain Leads to sequence roadmaps, unblock integration points, and ensure end-to-end business processes deliver seamlessly.
- Balance run-the-business with change-the-business work, ensuring the roadmap accounts for both new capability delivery and foundational platform investments
- Define and track success metrics — including adoption, throughput, transaction accuracy, cycle time, cost-to-serve, and platform SLAs — and use data to inform prioritization and continuous iteration.
- Communicate effectively across all levels, delivering clear updates to squads
- Champion product management best practices — PRDs, roadmaps, OKRs, discovery techniques, and stakeholder engagement models — and mentor peers to elevate the craft across the team.
- Stay ahead of industry trends in cloud integration, ERP modernization, iPaaS, event-driven architectures, and finance, procurement transformation, bringing outside-in perspective to shape the future of the platform.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Principal Technical Program Manager
Who We Are Looking For

You will drive key programs within the Consumer Product & Innovation portfolio. This role will lead diverse cross-function team members to execute complex and strategic programs. We are looking for a leader who has experience building program management functions and oversee end-to-end execution across multiple parallel program workstreams, including risk management, issue/conflict resolution and dependency management.

The ideal candidate for this position will be experienced in program management with strong leadership skills, technical capabilities, communication skills, and expertise with digital and technology transformations. This role requires exposure to both the breadth of knowledge across different technologies and the depth of understanding in key technical areas. This person will have demonstrated experience in an agile and program model structure. This candidate will serve as the single touchpoint for the program from WHQ and work in close partnership with your peer program managers at other geographies to deliver program outcomes. This role requires a candidate who is strong at building relationships across functions to align strategies and drive execution.

This candidate will be Single Point of Contact (SPOC) representing team in program reviews, business reviews to provide regular updates to stakeholders on end-to-end health and progress, and risk management. This person will be a strategic problem solver with an ability to prioritize multiple and competing priorities while driving a plan to execution.

- Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience
- Project Management Professional (PMP) preferred.
- 7+ years of Technical Program Management or product experience
- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams
- 5+ years of software development experience preferred
- Relevant experience in Retail, Consumer product development, Innovation, Supply Chain, and Operations preferred.
- Experience leading program management efforts including establishing effective governance structures, cross functional coordination, and executive stakeholder management and reporting.
- Strong relationship-building skills and experience working closely with senior executives and cross-functional partners to deliver key strategic initiatives.
- Experience running and executing across multiple complex technology platforms and business areas
- Strong oral and written communication skills and ability to challenge the status quo
- Ability to deal with ambiguity and work in a dynamic, results-oriented matrixed environment
- Delivery experience using Agile and Waterfall methodologies
- Deep experience with tools such as Miro, Lucid, JIRA, and Confluence
- Proven experience in a technical program management or engineering delivery role, with a strong ability to drive technical projects to successful completion.
- Deep understanding of Service Oriented Architecture Solutions.
- Broad technical understanding across a variety of platforms, systems, and engineering disciplines, like Front End, Dev ops, Cloud Services
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and vice versa.

We offer a number of accommodations to complete our interview process including screen readers, sign language interpreters, accessible and single location for in-person interviews, closed captioning, and other reasonable modifications as needed. If you discover, as you navigate our application process, that you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please complete the Candidate Accommodation Request Form .

jobs.title: Principal Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Principal Technical Product Manager – Consumer Product & Innovation, Nike
Beaverton, OR-USA

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

As Principal Technical Product Manager, you will own technical products in Design as part of Consumer Product & Innovation (CP&I), the technology engine behind Nike's product creation, merchandising, design, and innovation. You will partner closely with Design and Business Integration teams across Nike, Engineering, Architecture, and Program Management to bring Design’s vision and business outcomes to life. You will also work shoulder-to-shoulder with peers across CP&I and adjacent product organizations to align capabilities, evolve foundational tools, and shape the next generation of Nike's Design capabilities across Footwear, Apparel, and Accessories.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a seasoned product leader who deeply cares about their stakeholders, leads through craft, clarity, technical fluency, and broad influence, not through direct authority. You build a multi-year vision, with the discipline to deliver measurable outcomes one quarter at a time. You are equally comfortable shaping the future Product and Technology landscape, architecture with engineering and simplifying complex problems for executives, while partnering closely with Design users to turn workflow needs into products.

You have led complex product roadmaps, with measurable business outcomes and KPIs. You have earned the credibility to influence across product organizations that you do not directly manage. This is an individual contributor role. You will set direction, raise the bar of PMs across CP&I through informal mentorship, and lead through expertise rather than people management.

Key Qualifications :
- 8 to 12+ years of product management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, experience or training; advanced degree preferred
- Deep Subject Matter Expertise & experience in Design tools (2D/3D, Adobe, CLO, AI tools etc.)
- Proven experience in developing complex roadmaps, establishing measurement frameworks, product management best practices, and delivery of significant business impact
- Ability to influence and shape thinking of senior business and technical leadership within and outside the Design
- Experience with and/or ability to quickly learn complex systems and landscape
- Excellent communications skills (written and verbal) and strong interpersonal skills
- Experience with agile development methodologies, specifically SAFe, Kanban, and Scrum
- Exposure to AI/ML and Generative AI applied to enterprise product workflows
- Experience working on global products in consumer, footwear, apparel, or retail domains

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
As Principal Product Manager, you will own and lead a critical product(s) that enables the future of Design at Nike. You will lead its long-term product direction, business outcomes, technical evolution, delivery, and adoption. You will be a hands-on product leader, defining how the product integrates with the broader Design and CP&I ecosystem and delivers measurable value to its users and the business. Key accountabilities include,
- Partner with Design leadership to align on strategy, business outcomes, ‘highest value’ opportunities and define the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap
- Champion Product vision with Design and Global Technology leadership
- Drive disciplined product discovery, deeply engage in functional, technical design, delivery, and rollout, including change management, and adoption
- Partner with Architecture and Engineering teams to align on ‘Key design decisions’
- Align roadmaps and trade-offs with peer product teams across CP&I. Represent your platform in cross-org and global forums
- Deeply partner with vendors and technology partners to support prioritization of their features, aligned to Nike’s needs
- Push the boundaries of Design Tech by bringing new technologies like Gen/AgenticAI, and 3D into your roadmaps, where applicable
- Obsess product adoption, value tracking and business metrics/KPIs

We offer a number of accommodations to complete our interview process including screen readers, sign language interpreters, accessible and single location for in-person interviews, closed captioning, and other reasonable modifications as needed. If you discover, as you navigate our application process, that you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please complete the Candidate Accommodation Request Form .
